data.title: Navitas Semiconductor Acquires Patents in $10 Million Agreement
data.description:
An update from Navitas Semiconductor ( (NVTS) ) is now available.

On November 20, 2026, Navitas Semiconductor USA, Inc., an indirect subsidiary of Navitas Semiconductor Corporation, agreed to acquire certain patents and patent applications from Longitude Flash Memory Solutions Limited and Longitude Licensing Limited, two Irish private companies. The transaction also terminated certain intercompany licenses and agreements relating to the assigned patents.

Navitas agreed to pay $5 million within five business days of the agreement’s effective date and an additional $5 million upon the first specified triggering event, including a global lawsuit settlement or favorable trial verdict. It also agreed to pay 1.5% of gross licensing and other revenues from monetizing the patents, including the fair market value of non-cash consideration.

data.title: Tiziana Files FDA Safety Update Reporting No Serious Drug-Related Events for Intranasal Foralumab
data.description:
Tiziana Life Sciences ( (TLSA) ) has shared an announcement.

Tiziana Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing immunomodulation therapies through alternative drug-delivery technologies. Its lead candidate, intranasal foralumab, is a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody being studied in neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, including non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, multiple system atrophy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

On November 27, 2026, the company announced submitting an annual Development Safety Update Report to the FDA covering September 2, 2024, through September 30, 2026. The report found no drug-related serious adverse events across 48.1 patient-years of cumulative exposure, while the release said safety and tolerability remained favorable, no new risks led to significant protocol amendments, and the benefit-risk profile remained favorable across the clinical programs.

data.title: Digital Currency X Shareholders Approve 5-for-1 Consolidation, BVI Continuation Proposal
data.description:
Digital Currency X Technology ( (DCX) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Digital Currency X Technology Inc. reported that shareholders held a virtual extraordinary general meeting on November 25, 2026, with holders of approximately 90.88% of the company’s outstanding ordinary shares present or represented by proxy, constituting a quorum. The shareholders approved all three proposed resolutions.

The resolutions approved a five-for-one consolidation of Class A and Class B shares to take effect on a date confirmed by Nasdaq, related authorized-capital changes, and amended and restated constitutional documents. Shareholders also approved a proposal for the company to deregister in the Cayman Islands and continue as a British Virgin Islands business company, subject to governmental and regulatory consents.

data.title: FinVolution Group Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Overseas Revenue Rises
data.description:
An update from FinVolution Group ( (FINV) ) is now available.

FinVolution Group, a fintech platform facilitating loan transactions across China and overseas markets, announced on November 25, 2026, unaudited results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. In mainland China, transaction volume fell 66.8% year over year to RMB15.8 billion and outstanding loan balance fell 37.6% to RMB46.7 billion, while the 90-day-plus delinquency ratio was 2.50%.

Overseas transaction volume rose 11.1% to RMB4.0 billion, revenue increased 10.9% to RMB948.9 million and operating profit rose from RMB28.7 million to RMB62.1 million; overseas revenue represented 37.1% of total revenue. Group revenue was RMB2,557.9 million and net profit was RMB205.6 million, down from RMB3,486.6 million and RMB640.7 million, respectively, in the same period of 2025.

data.title: NuRAN Wireless Wins Approval for Up to €10 Million Côte d’Ivoire Financing
data.description:
An update from Nuran Wireless ( (NUR) ) is now available.

NuRAN Wireless is a rural telecommunications infrastructure company connecting remote and underserved African communities through its Network-as-a-Service model. It had more than 5,000 sites under contract, with a portion already built and operating.

On November 27, 2026, AFRIGREEN’s Investment Committee approved up to €10 million for NuRAN Wireless Côte d’Ivoire SARL to finance solar and energy-storage systems powering rural mobile sites being built for MTN Côte d’Ivoire. The approved project-level structure called for drawdowns of at least €1 million against sites commissioned and accepted by MTN CI, with debt secured by Ivorian project assets, the contract and receivables, and no equity-linked features.

data.title: Sanofi Announces U.S. Infilbray and EU VaxRabeo Approvals
data.description:
Sanofi ( (SNY) ) has issued an update.

Sanofi is an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company that develops medicines and vaccines, drawing on its understanding of the immune system to treat and protect people worldwide.

On November 18, 2026, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Infilbray (venglustat), an oral glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor that acts across the blood-brain barrier, for neurological manifestations of Type 3 Gaucher disease in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg. The approval was based on Phase 3 data showing statistically significant superiority over imiglucerase across multiple neurological endpoints. On November 19, 2026, the European Union approved Sanofi’s next-generation rabies vaccine, VaxRabeo, for all ages.

data.title: KT Corporation Files FY2026 Third-Quarter Auditor Review Reports
data.description:

KT Corporation is headquartered in Seongnam, South Korea, and filed a Form 6-K dated November 27, 2026. The filing included independent auditor review reports on its FY2026 third-quarter consolidated and separate financial statements.

The unaudited consolidated interim statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, reported operating revenue of 20,455,818 million Korean won, operating profit of 1,636,317 million won and profit attributable to the parent company of 1,113,610 million won, compared with 21,399,188 million, 2,241,770 million and 1,619,322 million, respectively, a year earlier. The auditor’s November 16 review concluded that nothing came to its attention indicating the statements were not prepared, in all material respects, under Korean IFRS; the review was not an audit opinion.

data.title: Metalla Adopts Shareholder Rights Plan Effective November 26
data.description:
Metalla Royalty & Streaming ( (TSE:MTA) ) has shared an announcement.

Metalla Royalty & Streaming is a royalty company focused on precious and strategic metals, acquiring royalties and streams to build a diversified portfolio. On November 27, 2026, it announced that its board had approved a shareholder rights plan effective November 26, intended to promote fair treatment in takeovers and protect against creeping bids.

The plan attached one right to each outstanding common share, with rights exercisable if a person acquired 20% or more of the shares outside the plan’s permitted-bid provisions. Metalla said the plan was not adopted in response to a specific control proposal; it remains subject to TSX Venture Exchange acceptance and shareholder ratification within six months, or it will terminate.
